# IRwaOracle
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rwa-oracles/src/interfaces/IRwaOracle.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IRwaOracleErrors](./i-rwa-oracle-errors.md), [IRwaOracleEvents](./i-rwa-oracle-events.md)

**Title:**
IRwaOracle

Interface for the Real World Asset (RWA) Oracle, managing authorized signers, signature verification
thresholds, and price updates.


## Functions
### updatePrice

Updates the current asset price by validating signed price payloads.


```solidity
function updatePrice(int256 price, uint256 timestamp, bytes[] calldata signatures) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`price`|`int256`|The new price value.|
|`timestamp`|`uint256`|The timestamp of the price generation.|
|`signatures`|`bytes[]`|Array of signatures validating the price update.|


### addSigner

Authorizes a new signer to participate in price updates.


```solidity
function addSigner(address signer) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`signer`|`address`|The address of the new signer.|


### removeSigner

Removes an authorized signer.


```solidity
function removeSigner(address signer) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`signer`|`address`|The address of the signer to remove.|


### setThreshold

Sets the signature threshold required to accept a price update.


```solidity
function setThreshold(uint256 threshold) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`threshold`|`uint256`|The number of unique signatures required.|
